## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 345 captures during July 2023. This activity represents the imaging completed at the site during the reporting month. The capture total provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 345 captures, 16 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.6. These results are reported separately from the grading outcome because ungradable captures could not be included in the assessment of referable findings.

## Grading

Grading identified 81 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This is the reported median for the month and provides an overall measure of the interval between image capture and completion of grading.
